# GameAtlas v1.4.0 — Backup, Diagnostics & Updater Improvements

GameAtlas v1.4.0 focuses on practical quality-of-life improvements to save backups, support diagnostics, and the in-app update experience.

## What's New

### Saved View Rename

User-created Saved Views can now be renamed directly in GameAtlas.

- Rename existing user-created Saved Views
- Saved View IDs and filter definitions remain unchanged
- Blank and duplicate names are rejected
- Built-in presets remain unchanged

### Per-Game Backup Retention

Save backups now support per-game retention controls.

Available retention choices:

- Unlimited
- Keep newest 5
- Keep newest 10
- Keep newest 20
- Keep newest 50

Retention applies to normal manual backups. Restore Safety and Pre-Launch backups are protected from normal retention pruning.

A **Clean Up Now** action is also available for explicitly removing old manual backups beyond the selected retention limit.

### Backup Notes

Manual backups can now include an optional note.

Examples:

- Before installing a graphics mod
- Known-good save before a boss fight
- Before changing game settings

Backup notes can be edited or removed later and are stored as GameAtlas metadata without modifying the backup ZIP.

### Per-Game Pre-Launch Backup Control

The Save Backup Manager now includes a per-game **Pre-Launch Backup** option.

This lets individual games override the global backup-before-launch preference while preserving the existing pre-launch backup workflow.

### Diagnostics Support Bundle

The Diagnostics screen can now create a sanitized ZIP support bundle.

A support bundle can include:

- application diagnostics
- system/hardware summary
- launcher status
- external-service status
- Library Analysis summary
- Installation Health summary
- backup-storage summary
- existing small GameAtlas log files when available
- a privacy/readme manifest

Support bundles intentionally exclude game installation paths, save paths, backup archives, backup filenames, user tags, Saved View names, account identifiers, updater private keys, and signing passwords.

### Updater UX Improvements

The signed Tauri updater has received a substantial UI improvement.

Updates now provide:

- clearer release notes
- release date when available
- explicit Downloading, Installing, and Ready to Restart states
- percentage and byte-level download progress
- retry after a failed update
- Restart GameAtlas after installation
- Remind Me Later
- Skip This Version

Skipping is exact-version only. Skipping one release does not prevent a newer release from appearing.

Manual update checks can still reveal a version that was previously skipped.

### Full Release Notes in the Updater

The release pipeline now places the full release-notes Markdown into `latest.json`, allowing the in-app updater's **What's New** section to show the actual release notes instead of only a version number.

## Compatibility & Data Continuity

GameAtlas v1.4.0 preserves the existing application identity and user-data continuity.

The release retains:

- Tauri identifier `com.greatdanish.gamemanager`
- existing updater signing identity
- existing updater endpoint
- existing `game-manager-*` preference and metadata keys
- existing GameManager application-data / backup root
- Favorites
- Tags
- Hidden games
- Saved Views
- settings
- Library Analysis data
- backup data

## Deferred for Future Releases

The following planned work was intentionally deferred rather than rushed into v1.4.0:

- backup scheduling
- persistent diagnostics logging and timing history
- additional Saved View / filtering work

## Platform

GameAtlas v1.4.0 continues to target Windows.

Linux support remains planned for GameAtlas v2.0.0.
